text: Ten fictional nonprofit programme passages, each paired with eight quote variants for citation-checker testing.

passages.source_passage: During the third quarter of 2023, the Kestrel Valley Playgroup Network operated 42 community playgroups across four districts. Attendance averaged 18 children per session, and 63% of caregivers attended at least two parenting circles. Facilitators reported that most toddlers now engage in shared storytelling for longer periods. However, the planned toy library in Morrow Bend did not open, because the donated shelving arrived damaged. Home visits were completed for 310 families, slightly below the target of 350. Monitoring staff noted that no playgroup closed during the rainy season, which marks an improvement on the previous year. Volunteers trained parents in simple counting games, and caregivers said the sessions were enjoyable and easy to repeat at home.

variants.exact: Attendance averaged 18 children per session, and 63% of caregivers attended at least two parenting circles.
variants.whitespace_case: FACILITATORS reported that most toddlers  now engage in shared storytelling for longer periods.
variants.punctuation: Monitoring staff noted that no playgroup closed during the rainy season which marks an improvement on the previous year.
variants.changed_quantity: the Kestrel Valley Playgroup Network operated 36 community playgroups across four districts
variants.added_negation: Home visits were not completed for 310 families, slightly below the target of 350.
variants.removed_negation: the planned toy library in Morrow Bend did open, because the donated shelving arrived damaged.
variants.reordered: Parents trained volunteers in simple counting games, and caregivers said the sessions were enjoyable and easy to repeat at home.
variants.paraphrase: Around eighteen children came to each session on average, and nearly two-thirds of caregivers joined two or more parenting circles.

passages.source_passage: Between March and August 2024, the Lowmere Farmer Field School Network enrolled 1,240 smallholders in 56 learning groups. Each group met every two weeks to compare plots of composted and uncomposted maize. By the end of the season, 71% of participants had adopted at least one soil conservation practice. Female members led 23 of the groups, up from nine in the previous cycle. The seed fair planned for July was not held because the access road to Tarrow Cross flooded. Facilitators also observed that few farmers kept written records, and the network has never provided notebooks as part of the starter kit. Extension officers advised farmers to sell surplus beans through the cooperative rather than to roadside traders.

variants.removed_negation: The seed fair planned for July was held because the access road to Tarrow Cross flooded.

variants.paraphrase: Hardly any participants recorded their farm activities on paper, and notebooks have never been included in the kits the network hands out.

passages.source_passage: As a volunteer caseworker in Sector C of Halvane Camp, you will usually support between 12 and 15 households at any one time. Always begin a first meeting by explaining confidentiality in the family's preferred language. Do not promise resettlement or cash assistance, because these decisions are not made by our team. If a child under 18 is living without a caregiver, refer the case to the protection officer within 24 hours. In 2023, roughly one third of urgent referrals reached us through volunteers rather than through the help desk. Record every contact on the paper form and hand it to your supervisor at the end of each shift. Never photograph documents on your personal phone.

passages.source_passage: The Saltreach coast is home to an estimated 86,000 people living in 31 fishing villages, most of them less than two metres above sea level. Since 2015, the district has experienced five cyclones strong enough to destroy boats and homes. During Cyclone Imara in 2021, many households did not receive any warning until the storm surge was already visible. Existing sirens cover only 40% of the shoreline, and several have not worked since the last major flood. The Tidewatch Alliance proposes to install solar-powered loudspeakers and train village volunteers to relay text alerts. Women and older residents, who were most often left behind during previous evacuations, will be involved in planning the routes.

passages.source_passage: This report covers the second year of the Dunmarra Drought-Resilient Crops Project, from October 2023 to September 2024. Rainfall in the project area was 38% below the long-term average, yet sorghum plots planted with the improved seed produced roughly twice the yield of local varieties. A total of 870 households received seed packs, and 214 of them also built small water-harvesting pits. Cowpea results were weaker than expected, and the team has not identified a variety suited to the sandy northern soils. Farmers who used mulching lost fewer seedlings during the dry spell in January. No household reported selling its seed stock to cover food costs, which the team regards as an encouraging sign.

passages.source_passage: Since the last board meeting in May, the Brightwater Community Counselling Service has held 1,105 individual sessions and 64 group sessions across its three hubs. Waiting times at the Elmgate hub fell from six weeks to under two. Client feedback has been largely positive, with 88% saying they would recommend the service to a friend. However, we did not meet our target for male clients, who still make up only a quarter of new referrals. Two counsellors resigned in July, and the vacancies have not been filled. Staff wellbeing remains a concern, and the leadership team recommends that the board approve funding for monthly clinical supervision.

passages.source_passage: The Open Paths Accessibility Project distributed 412 assistive devices between January and June 2024, including 150 wheelchairs, hearing aids and walking frames. Ramps were completed at 19 of the 25 schools on the original list. The remaining six schools were not reached because landlords had not given written permission. Device users reported that the lightweight wheelchairs made travel to market much easier. In contrast, the repair workshop in Calder Ford wasn't able to stock spare tyres for most of the period. Staff with disabilities now hold 30% of project roles, and the board is asked to note that recruitment of a sign-language interpreter is complete.

passages.source_passage: On distribution day, each volunteer team of three will cover about 120 households in the Pellam Hills catchment. Give one net for every two sleeping spaces, up to a maximum of four nets per household. Do not hand over nets to neighbours on behalf of absent families; mark the house for a return visit instead. Show each family how to hang the net and tuck it under the mattress. Pregnant women and children under five should sleep under a net every night, not only in the rainy season. In the 2022 campaign, fewer than half of households were using their nets correctly three months later, so the demonstration matters.

variants.paraphrase: In the earlier campaign, less than 50% of homes were hanging their nets properly after three months, which is why showing families how is important.

passages.source_passage: In the Koravi region, the Sahel Lantern Foundation currently supports hot midday meals in 48 primary schools serving around 16,500 pupils. A 2023 baseline survey found that 37% of children in grades one to three arrived at school without having eaten breakfast. Head teachers reported that attendance dropped sharply during the lean season from June to September. The existing menu relies heavily on imported rice and does not include locally grown millet, cowpeas or leafy greens. Parent committees have offered to supply firewood and cooking labour. This proposal seeks funding to extend the programme to 20 additional schools and to purchase at least half of all ingredients from nearby women's farming groups.

passages.source_passage: Since 2019, the Harrowgate Family Tracing Service has reunited 284 separated children with relatives across the Wennick border districts. Even so, an estimated 1,100 children remain in residential institutions, and many have not been visited by a social worker in over a year. Kinship and foster placements are cheaper than institutional care and produce better outcomes for most children. However, the district currently has only 37 approved foster families, and none of them is trained to care for adolescents with disabilities. Tracing is slow because birth records were never digitised. With this grant, Harrowgate will recruit and train 60 new foster carers over two years.
